IC1: Is not a habitual wearer of Avaira sphere lenses
IC2: Has a CL prescription outside the range of the available parameters of the study lenses.
IC3: Has a spectacle cylinder ≥1.00D of cylinder in either eye.
IC4: Has a history of [NOT] not achieving comfortable CL wear (5 days per week; > 8 hours/day)
IC5: Has contact lens best corrected distance vision worse than 20/25 (0.10 logMAR) in either eye.
IC6: Presence of clinically significant (grade 2-4) anterior segment abnormalities
IC7: Presence of ocular [OR] or systemic disease [OR] or need of medications which might interfere with contact lens wear.
IC8: Slit lamp [AND] findings that would contraindicate contact lens wear such as:
IC9: Pathological dry eye [OR] or associated findings
IC10: Pterygium [OR], pinguecula [OR], or corneal scars within the visual axis
IC11: Neovascularization > 0.75 mm in from of the limbus
IC12: Giant papillary conjunctivitis (GCP) worse than grade 1
IC13: Anterior uveitis [OR] or iritis (past [OR] or present)
IC15: History of corneal ulcers or fungal infections
IC17: Has a known history of corneal hypoesthesia (reduced corneal sensitivity)
IC18: Has aphakia [OR], keratoconus [OR] or a highly irregular cornea.
IC19: Has Presbyopia [OR] or has dependence on spectacles for near work over the contact lenses.
IC21: Is participating in any other type of eye related clinical or research study
